Message.MsgText: Missing credentials for HTTP basic authentication. Authorization HTTP header is required.

Explanation.p: HTTP authentication is required but the client did not provide credentials.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the web client sends credentials for HTTP basic authentication.

Message.MsgText: Unsupported HTTP authentication scheme authentication scheme. Use HTTP basic authentication.

Explanation.p: The Authorization HTTP header of the client request refers to an unsupported authentication scheme.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the web client uses HTTP basic authentication.

Message.MsgText: Invalid syntax of the Authorization HTTP header.

Explanation.p: The syntax of the credentials does not conform to the HTTP basic authentication specification.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the web client uses correct syntax for HTTP basic authentication.

Message.MsgText: Authentication failed for user username: exception

Explanation.p: Could not authenticate the specified user.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify the user credentials are correct.
